strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere ni feere cidenw porogaramu
strings.tierB.home.description: Porogaramu jɛnsɛnnikɛlaw ye: fakitiri ni resi ciden ka telefɔni kan, kamiyɔnɛti sitɔki, wari minɛni, siraw, lajɛliw. A bɛ baara kɛ ni rezo tɛ, ka ci kɔfɛ.
strings.tierB.home.h1: I ka feere cidenw ɲɛminɛ kabini lajɛli fɔlɔ fo wari minɛni laban
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales ye kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere ni feere cidenw porogaramu ye (logiciel de van sales), min bɛ baara kɛ ɛntɛrinɛti kan (cloud) fɛn jɛnsɛnni sosiyetew ni gurosisiw ye. Cidenw bɛ fakitiriw ni resiw bɔ u ka telefɔni kan ka u bɔ enpirimanti la, u bɛ kamiyɔnɛti sitɔki kɔlɔsi ani ka lajɛliw sɛbɛn. Ɲɛmɔgɔw bɛ feere, wari minɛni ani kiliyanw ka juruw ye u kɛ tuma yɛrɛ la.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Fakitiri ciden ka telefɔni kan
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Ciden bɛ fakitiri bɔ kiliyan ka butiki da la ka a bɔ Bluetooth enpirimanti la (imprimante thermique) sani ciden ka bɔ butiki la.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Wari minɛni ani kiliyanw ka juruw
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Sara o sara bɛ resi nimɔrɔma sɔrɔ min sirilen bɛ a sara fakitiriw la, ani kiliyan ka juru ni a ka jatebɔ sɛbɛn bɛ yɛlɛma yɔrɔnin kelen.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Kamiyɔnɛti sitɔki kɔlɔsili
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Kamiyɔnɛti kelen kelen bɛɛ ka sitɔki bɛ kɔlɔsi jagofɛn kelen kelen: min donina, min feerela, min seginna ani min tora, o la danfara o danfara bɛ ye o tile kelen na.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Siraw ani lajɛliw
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Lajɛli kelen kelen bɛɛ bɛ sɛbɛn ni yɔrɔ, waati ani jaw ye, ani ciden kelen kelen bɛɛ ka sira bɛ jira ɲɛmɔgɔ la karti kan.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: A bɛ baara kɛ ni ɛntɛrinɛti tɛ
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Cidenw bɛ to ka feere kɛ hali ni rezo tɛ. Sɛbɛnw bɛ to telefɔni kan; ni rezo seginna, porogaramu yɛrɛ bɛ u ci, sɛbɛn si tɛ jate siɲɛ fila.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Ɲɛmɔgɔw ka web ɛkaran
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Feere, wari minɛni, fɛn seginnenw, sitɔki ani cidenw ka baara, o bɛɛ bɛ yɔrɔ kelen na, ni jɔyɔrɔw ani yamaruyaw ye baarakɛla kelen kelen bɛɛ ye.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: A fɔ an ye i bɛ feere kɛ cogo min
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Sɔngɔ sɛbɛn ɲini walima ɲɔgɔnye latigɛ. An bɛ i ka cidenw, i ka siraw, i ka jagofɛnw ani i ka fakitiri magow lajɛ.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: I ka sosiyete labɛn
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Jagofɛnw, sɔngɔw, kiliyanw ani cidenw don a kɔnɔ, ka i ka jamana wari ni nisɔngɔ hakɛ sigi labɛnw (paramètres) kɔnɔ.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Cidenw bila sira kan
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Cidenw bɛ porogaramu bila u ka Android walima iPhone kan, ka u ka kamiyɔnɛti doni, ka feere kɛ, ka fakitiri bɔ enpirimanti la ani ka wari minɛ.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Tile kɔlɔsi a kɛ tuma yɛrɛ la
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Web ɛkaran bɛ feere, wari minɛni, kamiyɔnɛti sitɔki ani lajɛliw jira, k'a sɔrɔ cidenw bɛ sira kan hali bi.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales ye ɛntɛrinɛti porogaramu ye (cloud) min bɛ fɛn jɛnsɛnni sosiyetew ni gurosisiw dɛmɛ ka u ka feere cidenw ɲɛminɛ. A bɛ baara kɛ kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere (van sales), sira kan feere (route sales), komandi tali ka kɔn (pre-sales) ani fɛnw lase butikiw ma yɛrɛ (DSD) la. Cidenw bɛ fakitiri bɔ, ka a bɔ enpirimanti la, ka wari minɛ ani ka lajɛliw sɛbɛn u ka telefɔni kan; ɲɛmɔgɔw bɛ feere, wari minɛni, kamiyɔnɛti sitɔki ani kiliyanw ka juruw kɔlɔsi web ɛkaran kan.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.q: FieldSales bɛ baara kɛ ni ɛntɛrinɛti tɛ wa?
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Ɔwɔ. Cidenw ka porogaramu bɛ to ka baara kɛ ni ɛntɛrinɛti tɛ: cidenw bɛ fakitiriw ni resiw bɔ ka u bɔ enpirimanti la, ka lajɛliw sɛbɛn ani ka kiliyan kuraw don a kɔnɔ; ni rezo seginna, porogaramu yɛrɛ bɛ o bɛɛ ci, fosi tɛ jate siɲɛ fila. Danfara kelen bɛ Arabiya Sawudiya la: sosiyete minnu ka fakitiri ɛlɛkitoroniki sirili bɛ baara la, olu mago bɛ rezo la fakitiri walima fɛn seginni sɛbɛn bɔ waati la.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.q: FieldSales bɛ baara kɛ jamana jumɛnw na?
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales bɛ fɛn jɛnsɛnni sosiyetew dɛmɛ jamana bɛɛ la. Sosiyete kelen kelen bɛɛ bɛ a yɛrɛ ka wari ni a ka nisɔngɔ hakɛ sigi a ka labɛnw kɔnɔ, ani fakitiriw, resiw ni jatebɔ sɛbɛnw bɛ baara kɛ ni olu ye. FieldSales sigiyɔrɔ ye Riyadh ye, Arabiya Sawudiya, ani an bɛ i dɛmɛ ka daminɛ ɛntɛrinɛti kan: ɲɔgɔnyew, WhatsApp ani dɛmɛ yɔrɔjan fɛ.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales bɛ se ka siri fanga ka fakitiri ɛlɛkitoroniki sistɛmuw la wa?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: An bɛ Phase 2 sirili dɛmɛ ni ZATCA ka Fatoora platifɔrɔmu ye. O bɛ Arabiya Sawudiya sosiyetew dɔrɔn de ta ye. Jamana tɔw la, Mali fana, FieldSales bɛ fakitiriw bɔ ni i ka wari ni i ka nisɔngɔ hakɛ ye, ani jamana ka fakitiri ɛlɛkitoroniki sistɛmu sirili bɛ se ka kɛ ni i y'a ɲini, nka an bɛna o jamana ka sariyaw lajɛ i fɛ fɔlɔ. An tɛ layidu ta ko a bɛ bɛn sariyaw ma Arabiya Sawudiya kɔkan.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: FieldSales porogaramu bɛ kan jumɛnw na?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: FieldSales porogaramu ɲɛda (interface) bɛ arabukan, angilɛkan, faransikan, turukikan ani sinuwakan na, ani o kanw dɔrɔn de la. Bamanankan tɛ u la, nka faransikan bɛ u cɛma. Cidenw ni ɲɛmɔgɔw bɛ se ka ɲɛda kan yɛlɛma, ani fakitiri bɔlenw bɛ se ka kan filanan ta kan fɔlɔ kɛrɛ fɛ. Siti ɲɛ minnu bɛ kan wɛrɛw la, i n'a fɔ nin bamanankan ɲɛ in, olu ye bayɛlɛmaliw ye walasa ka kunnafoni di porogaramu kan.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.q: Ne bɛ se ka daminɛ cogo di ni FieldSales ye?
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Sɔngɔ sɛbɛn ɲini, ɲɔgɔnye latigɛ walima bataki ci an ma WhatsApp kan. An bɛ i ka cidenw ka baara cogo faamu, o kɔ an bɛ i dɛmɛ ka jagofɛnw, sɔngɔw, kiliyanw ani cidenw labɛn. Cidenw bɛ porogaramu bila u ka Android walima iPhone kan, ani ɲɛmɔgɔw bɛ web ɛkaran kɔlɔsi navigatɛri o navigatɛri kɔnɔ. Smartphone telefɔniw dɔrɔn de ye minɛnw ye i mago bɛ minnu na.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: FieldSales porogaramu ɲɛda bɛ arabukan, angilɛkan, faransikan, turukikan ani sinuwakan na; bamanankan tɛ u la. Kan wɛrɛw la, siti ɲɛw bɛ porogaramu ɲɛfɔ kunnafoni dɔrɔn kama.
strings.tierB.category.title: Kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere porogaramu gurosisiw ye | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere ni sira feere porogaramu: fakitiri bɔlen ciden ka telefɔni kan, sitɔki jagofɛn o jagofɛn, wari minɛni, lajɛliw. I mago tɛ rezo la.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere porogaramu fɛn jɛnsɛnnikɛlaw ni gurosisiw ye
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales ye kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere porogaramu ye sosiyetew ye minnu ka cidenw bɛ feere kɛ mobili kɔnɔ siraw kan don o don. Ciden bɛ kamiyɔnɛti doni, ka feere kɛ butiki kelen kelen bɛɛ la, ka fakitiri bɔ enpirimanti la, ka wari minɛ ani ka fɛn seginnenw sɛbɛn telefɔni porogaramu kelen kan. Ɲɛmɔgɔ bɛ nin ye kamiyɔnɛti kelen kelen bɛɛ kɔnɔ: min donina, min feerela, wari min minɛna ani min tora.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere porogaramu ye mun ye?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere porogaramu, min bɛ wele fana ko «cash van» walima «route sales» porogaramu, o bɛ feere cogo dɔ ɲɛminɛ: ciden bɛ sitɔki ta mobili kɔnɔ ka feere kɛ, ka fɛnw lase, ka fakitiri bɔ ani ka wari minɛ lajɛli kelen kɔnɔ. A bɛ fakitiri gafe sɛbɛnw ni tile laban telefɔni welew nɔ ta. A bɛ feere o feere, sara o sara ani seginni o seginni sɛbɛn, o la sitɔki ni wari bɛ se ka suma ɲɔgɔn na o tile kelen na. Ɲɛmɔgɔ kama, a bɛ ɲininkali saba jaabi wula o wula: ciden kelen kelen bɛɛ ye mun feere, a ye wari joli minɛ, ani mun tora kamiyɔnɛti kelen kelen bɛɛ kɔnɔ?
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Tile kelen sira kan
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Tile bɛ daminɛ ni doni sɛbɛnnen ye ka bɔ maraso la ka taa kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ. Butiki kelen kelen bɛɛ la, ciden bɛ kiliyan ka kunnafoni da wuli, ka jagofɛnw fara a kan lisi walima kodi-bari (barcode) fɛ, ka fakitiri bɔ ka a bɔ enpirimanti la. Sara bɛ sɛbɛn ni resi ye, ani seginni o seginni bɛ sɛbɛn ni a kun ye. Tile laban na, fɛn minnu tora kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ, olu bɛ jigin ka segin maraso la. O waati bɛɛ la, ɲɛmɔgɔ bɛ se ka ciden kelen kelen bɛɛ ka feere, wari minɛni ani lajɛliw kɔlɔsi web ɛkaran kan, k'a sɔrɔ a ma mɔgɔ si wele.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Dilannen rezo barikantan yɔrɔw kama
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Fɛn jɛnsɛnni siraw bɛ tɛmɛ dugukolo jukɔrɔ sow, izini yɔrɔw ani dugu fitininw fɛ, rezo man ɲi yɔrɔ minnu na. FieldSales cidenw ka porogaramu bɛ kiliyanw, jagofɛnw ani sɔngɔw mara telefɔni kan, o la ciden bɛ se ka sɛbɛnw bɔ ka u bɔ enpirimanti la ni ɛntɛrinɛti tɛ. Sɛbɛn kelen kelen bɛɛ bɛ ni a yɛrɛ ka taamasiyɛn ye min tɛ sɛbɛn wɛrɛ si la, o la a bɛ sɛbɛn sistɛmu kɔnɔ siɲɛ kelen dɔrɔn, hali ni porogaramu y'a ci kokura. Arabiya Sawudiya sosiyete minnu ka fakitiri ɛlɛkitoroniki sirili bɛ baara la, olu mago bɛ rezo la fakitiriw ni fɛn seginniw bɔ waati la. Resiw, lajɛliw ani kiliyan kuraw bɛ to ka baara kɛ ni ɛntɛrinɛti tɛ olu fana fɛ.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Wari minɛni ani kamiyɔnɛti kɔlɔsili
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Wari min bɛ sira kan, o mago bɛ kɔlɔsili la i n'a fɔ sitɔki. Wari minɛni kelen kelen bɛɛ bɛ resi nimɔrɔma sɔrɔ min bɛ se ka siri a sara fakitiriw la, ani kiliyan ka juru bɛ yɛlɛma yɔrɔnin kelen. Kamiyɔnɛti sitɔki bɛ jate jagofɛn kelen kelen: min donina, ka min feerela bɔ a la, ka fɛn seginnenw ni yɛlɛmali sɛbɛnnenw fara a kan, o la ɲɛmɔgɔw bɛ se k'a suma fɛnw jate yɛrɛ la sani ciden ka segin so. Fɛn seginnenw bɛ se ka tila sugu saba la: fɛn ɲumanw (normal), fɛn tiɲɛnenw walima falenni, ani ɲɛmɔgɔ de b'a latigɛ ni fɛn seginnenw bɛ segin kamiyɔnɛti sitɔki la min bɛ se ka feere.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: A bɛnnen don sosiyete jumɛnw ma?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales bɛnnen don fɛn jɛnsɛnnikɛlaw ni gurosisiw ma, minnu ka jagofɛnw bɛ feere joona, i n'a fɔ dumuniw, minfɛnw, saniyali fɛnw ani farikolo saniya fɛnw, ani sosiyete o sosiyete min ka cidenw bɛ taa butikiw la siraw kan. A bɛ kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere, komandi tali ka kɔn (pre-sales) ani fɛnw lase butikiw ma yɛrɛ (DSD) dɛmɛ. FieldSales tɛ ERP dafalen ye: a bɛ siri i ka jatebɔ walima ERP sistɛmu la API fɛ. Ɲɛmɔgɔw bɛ a latigɛ ciden kelen kelen bɛɛ bɛ se ka min kɛ, i n'a fɔ ka dɔgɔyali kɛ, ka feere kɛ sɔngɔ sigilen jukɔrɔ walima ka kiliyan kuraw fara a kan.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere ni komandi tali ka kɔn (pre-sales) danfara ye mun ye?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere la, ciden bɛ sitɔki ta, ka fɛnw lase, ka fakitiri bɔ ani ka wari minɛ lajɛli kelen kɔnɔ. Pre-sales la, ciden bɛ komandi ta, ani maraso bɛ fɛnw lase kɔfɛ. FieldSales bɛ u fila bɛɛ dɛmɛ, o la sosiyete bɛ se ka kamiyɔnɛtiw bila siraw dɔw kan, ka komandi tali kɛ siraw wɛrɛw kan. U fila bɛɛ la, fakitiriw, wari minɛni ani kiliyanw ka juruw bɛ sistɛmu kelen kɔnɔ, ani ɲɛmɔgɔw bɛ u ye jatebɔ sɛbɛn kelenw kɔnɔ.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Ne bɛ kamiyɔnɛti jate suma cogo di tile laban na?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales bɛ jagofɛn kelen kelen bɛɛ jira kamiyɔnɛti kelen kelen bɛɛ kɔnɔ: hakɛ min donina, min feerela, min seginna ani min tora. Min tora, i b'o suma fɛnw jate yɛrɛ la, danfara o danfara bɛ sɛbɛn i n'a fɔ yɛlɛmali sɛbɛnnen, o kɔ tɔ bɛ jigin ka segin maraso la siɲɛ kelen. Kamiyɔnɛti bɛ sini tile daminɛ ni jate saniyalen ye min dɔnnen don.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Ciden min bɛ feere kɛ kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ, o mago bɛ minɛn jumɛnw na?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Smartphone telefɔni kelen, Android walima iPhone. Bluetooth enpirimanti (imprimante thermique) tɛ wajibi ye; a bɛ ciden dɛmɛ ka fakitiri walima resi bɔlen di kiliyan ma. FieldSales tɛ minɛnw feere, a tɛ enpirimanti marka kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen wajibiya. Ɲɛmɔgɔw bɛ web ɛkaran kɔlɔsi ɔridinatɛri walima telefɔni navigatɛri o navigatɛri la.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales bɛ se ka siri an ka jatebɔ sistɛmu la wa?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Ɔwɔ. FieldSales bɛ API di min b'a to i ka jatebɔ walima ERP sistɛmu ka kiliyanw, jagofɛnw, fakitiriw, resiw ani sitɔki taamaw falen ni platifɔrɔmu ye. I ka jɛkulu walima i ka sirili baarakɛla bɛ sirili in dilan ni API gafe ye.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales jamanaw la: wari, nisɔngɔ, e-fakitiri
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales bɛ baara kɛ fɛn jɛnsɛnnikɛlaw ye jamana bɛɛ la. Jamana kelen kelen bɛɛ ka wari, nisɔngɔ ani e-fakitiri cogo lajɛ tabulo kelen kɔnɔ.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales bɛ fɛn jɛnsɛnni sosiyetew dɛmɛ jamana bɛɛ la. Sosiyete kelen kelen bɛɛ bɛ a ka jamana, a ka wari ani a ka nisɔngɔ hakɛ sugandi a ka labɛnw kɔnɔ, ani fakitiriw, resiw ni jatebɔ sɛbɛnw bɛ tugu olu kɔ. Fanga ka fakitiri ɛlɛkitoroniki sirili bɛ baara la Arabiya Sawudiya dɔrɔn de la. Jamana tɔ bɛɛ la, a bɛ se ka kɛ ni i y'a ɲini. Tabulo min bɛ duguma, o bɛ jamana kelen kelen bɛɛ ka wari jira, a ka nisɔngɔ hakɛ min bɛ kɛ tuma caman (TVA), ani ni fanga ka fakitiri ɛlɛkitoroniki sirili bɛ baara la walima a bɛ se ka kɛ ni i y'a ɲini.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: An bɛ Phase 2 sirili dɛmɛ ni ZATCA ka Fatoora platifɔrɔmu ye
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingOnRequest: A bɛ se ka kɛ ni i y'a ɲini
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Sosiyete kelen kelen bɛɛ bɛ wari ni nisɔngɔ hakɛ sigi a yɛrɛ ka labɛnw kɔnɔ. Hakɛ minnu bɛ tabulo in kɔnɔ, olu ye bilasirali dɔrɔn ye, u bɛ se ka yɛlɛma; sariya minnu bɛ baara la sisan, olu lajɛ i ka nisɔngɔ ladilikɛla fɛ. Taamasiyɛn (—) kɔrɔ ye ko hakɛ si ma sɛbɛn o jamana kama.
strings.tierB.about.title: FieldSales ka kunnafoniw
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales bɛ ɛntɛrinɛti porogaramu dilan fɛn jɛnsɛnni sosiyetew ye minnu ka feere cidenw bɛ sira kan. A sigira 2026 san na Riyadh, Arabiya Sawudiya.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (a tɔgɔ arabukan na ye فيلد سيلز) ye ɛntɛrinɛti porogaramu ye (cloud) fɛn jɛnsɛnni sosiyetew ni gurosisiw ye minnu ka feere cidenw bɛ sira kan. FieldSales sigira 2026 san na, a sigiyɔrɔ ye Riyadh ye, Arabiya Sawudiya. A bɛ sosiyetew dɛmɛ jamana bɛɛ la, ani jamana kelen kelen bɛɛ ka wari ni a ka nisɔngɔ hakɛ bɛ sigi sosiyete yɛrɛ ka labɛnw kɔnɔ. An ka kiliyanw ye sosiyetew ye minnu bɛ feere kɛ ka fɛnw lase cidenw fɛ sira kan: fɛn jɛnsɛnnikɛlaw, gurosisiw ani izinitigiw minnu yɛrɛ ka feere mobiliw bɛ yen.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: An bɛ sistɛmu kelen dilan min bɛ sira kan baara bɛɛ minɛ: fakitiriw bɛ bɔ ciden ka telefɔni kan ka bɔ enpirimanti la, resiw ani kiliyanw ka juruw, kamiyɔnɛti sitɔki kɔlɔsili, siraw ani lajɛliw ni yɔrɔ ani jaw ye, ani web ɛkaran ɲɛmɔgɔw ye. Cidenw ka porogaramu bɛ baara kɛ Android ni iPhone kan, a bɛ to ka baara kɛ ni ɛntɛrinɛti tɛ, o kɔ a bɛ ci ni rezo seginna. Sosiyetew bɛ se ka FieldSales siri u ka jatebɔ walima ERP sistɛmu la API fɛ, o la sira kan kunnafoniw tɛ sɛbɛn siɲɛ fila.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: An bɛ porogaramu ɲɛfɔ a cogo yɛrɛ la. An bɛ Phase 2 sirili dɛmɛ ni ZATCA ka Fatoora platifɔrɔmu ye. Fanga ka sistɛmuw sirili jamana wɛrɛw la, o bɛ se ka kɛ ni i y'a ɲini. Porogaramu ɲɛda bɛ arabukan, angilɛkan, faransikan, turukikan ani sinuwakan na; bamanankan tɛ u la. Walasa ka kuma an fɛ, sɔngɔ sɛbɛn ɲini, ɲɔgɔnye latigɛ walima bataki ci an ma WhatsApp kan.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Kuma FieldSales fɛ
strings.tierB.contact.description: Kuma FieldSales jɛkulu fɛ: sɔngɔ sɛbɛn ɲini, ɲɔgɔnye latigɛ walima kuma an fɛ WhatsApp kan feere cidenw ni kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ feere porogaramu ko la.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: A fɔ an ye i ka cidenw bɛ feere kɛ cogo min bi, ani i b'a fɛ ka mun yɛlɛma. Sɔngɔ sɛbɛn ɲini, ɲɔgɔnye latigɛ walima bataki ci an ma WhatsApp kan, ani an ka jɛkulu mɔgɔ dɔ bɛna i jaabi. Dɛmɛ kama, an ka kiliyanw bɛ se ka o fɛɛrɛ kelenw ta. A ka ɲi ni i ye i ka jamana fɔ, i ka cidenw hakɛ, ani ni u bɛ feere kɛ kamiyɔnɛti kɔnɔ, u bɛ komandi ta, walima u bɛ u fila bɛɛ kɛ.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Ɲɔgɔnye latigɛ an ka jɛkulu fɛ ɛntɛrinɛti kan. An bɛna ciden ka tile kelen jira i la porogaramu kɔnɔ, ani ɲɛmɔgɔ ka web ɛkaran, ni misaliw ye minnu surun i ka jagofɛnw ni i ka siraw la, ani ka i ka ɲininkaliw jaabi labɛn ko la.
